summary: Permanent housing where residents have a private unit and share some dwelling functions. The building rules call the private unit a 'boendeenhet' (BFS 2024:11 1 kap. 5 §). They distinguish two cases. (1) Units for ONE person (co-living, also student corridors): socialising, cooking and meals may be fully shared, the kitchen by at most 12 persons, and hygiene rooms by at most 3 units on the same floor (2 kap. 7-8 §§). (2) Units for SEVERAL persons (kollektivhus, family co-housing): socialising, cooking and meals may only be PARTLY shared, as a complement to functions inside each unit, and hygiene may not be shared (2 kap. 9 §). The tenancy contract decides the classification: separate contracts per unit means boendeenheter, while one joint contract means the whole is a single large ordinary dwelling (Boverket, based on hyreslagen). Co-living is a 'bostad' (permanent), not a hotel, so all dwelling rules apply. Unlike student housing it gets no accessibility exemption, and the bed help-space requirement applies in every unit. Fire class 3B with mandatory stove guards.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 3B — 'bostäder med boendeenheter' incl. common rooms (BFS 2024:7, 2 kap. 15 §). Stove guard with overheating protection on cookers used by residents (4 kap. 25 §). A group of units for at most 6 persons incl. its common room may form one fire compartment; otherwise each unit is its own compartment unless the group is protected by sprinklers or a residential sprinkler system (5 kap. 25 § p. 4 and 6). Doors to units: see 5 kap. (door list incl. 'Dörr till bostad och boendeenhet i verksamhetsklass 3B'). If it is let on one joint contract (one large dwelling), class 3A applies instead (assumption based on the definitions; verify with the fire consultant).

key_laws.ref: BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 § second paragraph; 3 kap. 2 § (stretcher transport from each boendeenhet)
Jordabalken 12 kap. (hyreslagen): the contract defines the bostadslägenhet

permits: Bygglov for change of use: PBL 9 kap. 15 § p. 1-2.

Detaljplan must permit Bostäder. Co-living with short lets and hotel-like services may be judged 'Tillfällig vistelse' instead (Boverket: a hotel is not a dwelling even with full home facilities; the purpose decides).
State the contract model (individual vs joint) in the bygglov application, since it decides which BFS 2024:11 rules apply.
regulatory.operator_oversight: Byggnadsnämnden. Rent setting under hyreslagen / bruksvärde applies to each contract; no special licensing.

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Working value; no Swedish source found. Placed between student corridor housing and ordinary rental flats (SCB 2025: 35 m² BOA per person in rented flats).

staff_per_unit.source: Commercial co-living often has a community manager (about 1 per 100 residents); working value, unsourced.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Indicative weekday profile for working adults, a bit higher daytime presence than ordinary housing because of remote work. Unsourced.
occupancy.persons_per_dwelling_note: One-person units: 1. Multi-person units (kollektivhus): per unit, as for ordinary dwellings.

spaces.label_en: Private unit (boendeenhet) with sleep/rest and daily storage

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 1 kap. 5 § (boendeenhet), 2 kap. 1 §; BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 § second paragraph (help space along both long sides and the foot of a bed in EACH boendeenhet; no student exemption)

size.source: No m² in regulation. Note: the bed help-space rule makes co-living units bigger than student corridor rooms for the same function.

spaces.notes: Daylight DF >= 1.0 % in the unit and in shared-function rooms (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 1 §). Stretcher transport must be possible from every boendeenhet (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 2 §). A private kitchenette is allowed in addition to the shared kitchen.

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 3 § (room for personal hygiene in the dwelling). Mandatory inside each unit for multi-person units (2 kap. 9 § allows no hygiene sharing). For one-person units it may be replaced by shared rooms (2 kap. 8 §). At least one hygiene room per dwelling must be accessible (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 9 §).

size.count: one per unit (or shared, see below)
size.source: No m²; dwelling wheelchair dimensions per BFS 2024:12 1 kap. 6 § (turning circle 1.30 m).

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 8 § (at most three one-person units per hygiene room, adjacent, same floor)

One-person units: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 7 § (fully shareable, <= 12 persons, adjacent, sized for those sharing) and 3 kap. 4 §. Multi-person units: 2 kap. 9 § (only partly shared, as a complement to cooking inside each unit). Stove guards: BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 25 §.

spaces.shareable_note: Shared rooms may be on another floor only if reachable by internal communication without passing public stairwells (Boverket).

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 7 § (one-person units) or 2 kap. 9 § (multi-person units, partly shared). For multi-person units Boverket says the shared areas must be large enough to complement the smaller private areas (fullgod kompensation in the old BBR 3:226 (repealed BBR, pre-2025)).

size.source: Boverket: the rules do not state how large shared areas must be.

spaces.notes: For one-person-unit buildings the outlook requirement does not apply to shared socialising/meal spaces (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 2 §), but DF >= 1.0 % does. For multi-person units (kollektivhus) outlook also applies to the shared rooms.

spaces.label_en: Bulky item room (bikes, prams, mobility aids)

required.basis: BFS 2026:4 2 kap. 2 § (>= 2 per bostadslägenhet in a new flerbostadshus; adaptation allowed where the building mainly contains one-person dwellings); on alteration only for ombyggnad involving car parking (1 kap. 4 §)

size.source: Count only. Whether a boendeenhet counts as a 'bostadslägenhet' for this rule was not checked.

spaces.label_en: Amenity rooms (co-working, gym, guest room, event space)

required.basis: Operator concept; not required by law.

spaces.shareable_note: Co-working can be opened to the neighbourhood in the daytime.
spaces.notes: Fits deep, low-daylight office zones. A guest room let to non-residents moves toward Vk 4 (temporary stay); check with the fire consultant.

variants.label: Co-living, one-person units with individual contracts
variants.changes: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 7-8 §§: full sharing of kitchen (<= 12), living and dining; optional shared hygiene (<= 3 units/room, same floor). Vk 3B.

variants.label: Kollektivhus, multi-person units (families/couples)
variants.changes: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 9 §: each unit keeps its own kitchen, living, dining and bathroom; shared kitchen, dining room and living room only as a complement. Hygiene never shared. Outlook required in shared rooms.

variants.label: Shared large flat on one joint contract
variants.changes: Not boendeenheter: treated as one ordinary dwelling (>55 m² in old BBR 3:222 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) language), so every function must exist inside the one dwelling. Vk 3A (assumed).

typical_blockers: Daylight DF >= 1.0 % in each unit and in shared-function rooms.
Bed help-space requirement in each unit (no student exemption) pushes room width and area up.
Full accessibility (no 80 % exemption as for students).
Fire compartments per group of at most 6 persons or sprinklers, plus stove guards (Vk 3B).
typical_enablers: Shared kitchen/living for up to 12 persons and shared hygiene for up to 3 units cut wet rooms and kitchens.
No outlook requirement for shared rooms in one-person co-living, so they can go deeper in the plan.
Office floors with many WC/shower points near cores suit shared hygiene clusters.

open_questions: Sound: BFS 2024:10 has a special table only for STUDENT dwellings with boendeenheter (table 2:3). For non-student co-living it is unclear whether table 2:1 applies between boendeenheter (as separate dwellings) or whether no internal requirement applies (as parts of one dwelling). Boverket guidance says separate contracts make separate dwellings, while BFS defines a boendeenhet as 'del av en bostad'. Ask Boverket or an acoustician.
Does a boendeenhet count as a 'bostadslägenhet' for BFS 2026:4 bicycle counts (2 per apartment)?
Boundary with hotel/aparthotel: short-stay co-living with services might be classed as 'Tillfällig vistelse' and Vk 4. Not tested against case law.
No m² source for co-living units or shared rooms in Sweden. Benchmarks from operators (e.g. existing Swedish co-living projects) needed.
Fire class for the joint-contract shared flat (assumed 3A) to be confirmed.
